title: Parking Release Surcharge in Lease Term Agreement Lease Breaks
content:
A lease break on a Lease Term Agreement carries a parking release surcharge in its reletting fee. The parking release surcharge is set by the household's active parking license: a Structured Garage Space, EV Charging Reserved Space or Private Detached Garage adds 50.00 dollars; any other active parking license adds 25.00 dollars; no active parking license adds nothing.

The part of the reletting fee obtained by applying the reletting rate to the contracted rent is rounded half up to the cent, and the surcharge is then added to it.

| Active Parking License product | Parking release surcharge |
|---|---|
| Structured Garage Space | 50.00 dollars |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | 50.00 dollars |
| Private Detached Garage | 50.00 dollars |
| Surface Unreserved Permit | 25.00 dollars |
| Surface Reserved Space | 25.00 dollars |
| Covered Carport Space | 25.00 dollars |
| No active Parking License | nothing |

A Parking License counts only in active status; a waitlisted, suspended, on-notice, terminated or withdrawn license is not an active parking license.

*Illustration (hypothetical).* A household holding an active EV Charging Reserved Space adds 50.00 dollars; one holding only a suspended Surface Reserved Space adds nothing.
